source_snapshot.test_name: FIO Random bandwidth/IOPS (100% write @ 1 queue at QD1 (bs=512B, numjobs=1)
source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Measure M.2 100% random-write bandwidth/IOPS with 512-byte blocks, one job and QD1, then compare fio results with the M.2 specification.
procedure_facts: Use libaio, direct=1, randwrite, 512-byte blocks, iodepth=1, numjobs=1, 10-second ramp and time-based 43200-second runtime.
Use norandommap=1, randrepeat=0, refill_buffers and overwrite=1.
Run `./fio randwrite.fio` and collect results and logs.
criteria_facts: fio reports performance results that match the unspecified specification.
source_conflicts: The job requests `runtime=43200s` (12 hours), while Machine Time is 60 minutes.
The job omits filename/directory, size/filesize and offset, leaving the destructive target/range undefined.
The procedure installs a system fio package but invokes an unproven local `./fio`.
missing_source_information: Persistent M.2 device/namespace identity, raw-versus-file scope and bounded range.
Whether the M.2 device uses NVMe/PCIe or SATA/AHCI and the actual controller path.
Logical/physical block size and 512-byte O_DIRECT alignment support.
Authoritative 12-hour versus 60-minute duration, random seed/repeat policy, preconditioning and steady-state window.
Numeric IOPS/BW/latency thresholds, cache policy, endurance/write-amplification/thermal limits and restore/reprovision.

original_test_intent.statement: Run a sustained destructive 512-byte 100%-random-write fio workload with one job and effective QD1 over an explicitly bounded empty M.2 target range, preserving the source's 43200-second request until its duration conflict is resolved, and compare stable performance and device-health evidence with the matching specification.
must_preserve: M.2 target and random 100% write, not sequential write or read.
Direct libaio, source random policy and 10-second ramp where supported.
The 43200-second runtime unless formally revised after reconciling Machine Time 60.
Destructive approval, complete fio evidence, device health and specification comparison.
20/60-minute planning metadata without treating it as completion.
must_not_infer: That M.2 means NVMe/PCIe rather than SATA/AHCI.
A target/range from transient device naming.
That 512-byte O_DIRECT is valid on a 4Kn or differently aligned stack.
That a 60-second or 60-minute run is equivalent to 43200 seconds.
That fio success or a transient peak proves stable performance or acceptable endurance.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly requires a disposable M.2 target, bounded destructive range, QD1, full output, data-loss approval, health monitoring and restore/recovery.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 permits a shorter approved duration without treating 43200 seconds versus Machine Time 60 as a source conflict, assumes PCIe/controller evidence for any M.2, and omits 512-byte direct-I/O alignment, random distribution/seed evidence, steady-state definition and quantified endurance/write-amplification budget.

related_records: Other fio cases cannot supply this row's M.2 transport, random-write media state, target/range, duration or threshold; the sequential-write case is not evidence for this random profile.
applicable_history.precedence_application: The title and job agree on QD1 random write. The 43200-second job versus 60-minute metadata remains SOURCE_CONFLICT and cannot be shortened at execution time without a formal testcase revision.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep the case technically automatable after handoff, but prohibit writes until target/range, transport, 512-byte alignment, 43200s-versus-60min, exact fio binary, media/preconditioning/spec, endurance limits and recovery are signed. A shorter run is a formal revision, not a runtime choice.

conditions_present: The source supplies randwrite, 512-byte blocks, QD1, one job, libaio/direct I/O, random options, ramp and a 12-hour runtime.
missing: Persistent target/range, M.2 transport, alignment, duration resolution, exact fio build, media/cache/preconditioning and stable-window policy, thresholds, endurance/thermal limits and recovery.
provider: Storage owner designates the sacrificial M.2 target/range, confirms transport and accepts data loss/endurance consumption.
Performance engineer resolves duration and supplies random/preconditioning/cache/steady-state profile plus numeric thresholds.
Platform/lab owner verifies topology, monitoring, maintenance window, abort limits and recovery.
safe_read_only_work: Record by-id/WWN/EUI/serial/model/firmware/capacity, namespace, NVMe/PCIe or SATA/AHCI path, logical/physical block sizes, partitions/mount/LVM/RAID/swap and active I/O.
Record fio/kernel/libaio versions and parse/show the proposed job without I/O.
Collect SMART/NVMe health, percentage used/endurance, temperature, error logs, dmesg/SEL and idle telemetry without clearing or changing media.
prohibited_until_resolved: Package installation, unmount/format/secure-erase/trim/preconditioning, cache changes, fio write, target/file creation, log clearing, reset/reboot or PASS.
closure_evidence: Two independent identity views bind an empty sacrificial bounded target and exclude boot/root/data/RAID/LVM/swap.
Signed decision resolves 43200s/60min, proves 512-byte aligned direct I/O and validates the exact fio binary/job.
Transport-matched spec, random/media/cache/preconditioning/steady-state profile, endurance/thermal limits, approval and restore/recovery are ready.

revision_candidate.test_name: Measure QD1 512-Byte Random-Write Performance on an M.2 Device
revision_candidate.purpose: Measure sustained 100% random-write bandwidth, IOPS and latency with 512-byte blocks, one job and effective QD1 over one explicitly bounded empty M.2 range for the full approved 43200-second measurement, then compare stable performance and post-write endurance/health evidence with a transport- and profile-matched specification.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Only the signed M.2 device/namespace, its actual NVMe/PCIe or SATA/AHCI controller path, firmware, kernel, fio/libaio version, filesystem-or-raw scope and cache/preconditioning policy. Execute on a dedicated non-production host using persistent identity. Raw-device and file profiles and NVMe versus SATA M.2 are not interchangeable.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One explicitly empty sacrificial M.2 device/namespace or one bounded disposable file, with exact offset and size/filesize; randwrite, bs=512B, numjobs=1, direct=1, libaio, effective iodepth=1, ramp_time=10s and time_based runtime=43200s. Any secure erase/trim/preconditioning is a separately approved setup step. Machine Time 60 remains a source conflict; a shorter run requires a formal revised case. Preserve 20/60-minute metadata as planning values only.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Persistent target identity and transport/topology; proof target is empty/sacrificial and not boot/root/data/RAID/LVM/swap; raw-versus-file, exact filename/device, offset and size; logical/physical block sizes and 512-byte direct-I/O alignment proof; fio/kernel/libaio binary versions/hash; formal duration decision; firmware/cache/power/random seed-repeat/preconditioning/steady-state policy; numeric IOPS/BW/latency spec and units; output/monitoring cadence; host-write versus NAND-write/endurance budget when exposed; thermal/media/controller/host abort limits; maintenance window; data-loss approval; restore/reprovision and recovery.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Preserve two independent target identities, topology/transport, alignment, health/endurance, logs and exact job before writes. Parse/show the job without I/O and use the approved fio executable, never assume `./fio`. Perform only the separately approved media preparation, then capture the resulting baseline. Immediately before start, recheck identity/range and obtain destructive approval. Run one bounded job with `rw=randwrite`, `bs=512b`, `numjobs=1`, `ioengine=libaio`, `direct=1`, `iodepth=1`, `ramp_time=10s`, `runtime=43200s`, `time_based`, `group_reporting` and signed filename/size/offset/random/cache settings. Capture full text and machine output, achieved depth, random distribution policy, stable-window IOPS/BW/latency, total host bytes written, device/NAND writes when available, errors, temperature/health and host logs. Do not run until duration is formally closed.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Dedicated non-production SUT; empty sacrificial bounded target verified by persistent identity immediately before run; no mount, swap, RAID/LVM/data or active-I/O conflict; 512-byte direct I/O supported/aligned; data-loss/endurance approval; duration conflict resolved; exact random job/spec/cache/preconditioning/steady-state state frozen; sufficient cooling/power/evidence storage; baseline health/endurance acceptable; abort monitoring and restore/recovery tested.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Two-view target/exclusion and transport identity; logical/physical block and 512-byte alignment proof; model/serial/firmware/controller/fio/kernel/libaio versions; signed duration/range/spec decision; checksummed job/executable/command; raw/file, offset, size, cache, random-seed/repeat, preconditioning and stable-window state; full 43200-second measured window; achieved QD1; complete output; random-write IOPS/BW, mean/percentile latency, errors and host bytes written; device/NAND writes or explicit unavailability; time-series temperature/health/endurance/controller data; dmesg/syslog/SEL; before/after SMART/NVMe health; restore/reprovision evidence; final health and engineer disposition.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The signed specification for the exact M.2 transport/device/controller/firmware, QD1, 512-byte random-write, one-job, direct-I/O, range, random/cache/preconditioning/steady-state and duration profile. Pass requires the full 43200-second accepted window, effective QD1, zero disallowed I/O/media/controller errors, all stable metrics meeting thresholds and acceptable endurance/health. A shorter run, misaligned I/O, unbounded target or unmatched vendor headline is insufficient.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not infer target or M.2 transport; use transient device names without persistent identity; write boot/root, mounted data, swap, RAID/LVM or protected namespaces; omit/broaden range; issue misaligned 512-byte direct I/O; secure-erase/trim/precondition/change cache without separate approval; shorten 12 hours; use unverified `./fio`; clear logs or retry automatically. Stop on identity/topology/alignment drift, out-of-range I/O, I/O/media/controller error, temperature/endurance limit, device disappearance, host instability or monitoring loss.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Storage owner designates the sacrificial target, accepts irreversible loss and endurance use, and approves restore; performance engineer signs transport, QD1, 43200 seconds, range, random/cache/preconditioning/steady-state profile and thresholds; platform/lab owner approves maintenance and recovery; a human rechecks identity and authorizes the destructive run immediately before start and judges PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Humans select/isolate the disposable target, resolve duration, approve media preparation and own specification/recovery decisions. An Agent may inventory, parse the job, execute separately approved setup and one measured run after each gate, monitor and package evidence; it may not select a device, change transport/profile, shorten, self-authorize or retry.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On wrong-target/range indication, media/controller error, thermal/endurance breach, device loss or host instability, stop fio cleanly if safe, freeze further writes, preserve output and before/after health/log evidence, and use only approved controller reset, power cycle, replacement, reformat or reprovision. Revalidate identity/topology/health before reuse; no rerun without fresh approval.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Persistent target/range/exclusion proof, transport, duration resolution, exact fio executable/job, 512-byte alignment, random/cache/preconditioning/steady-state profile, numeric spec, data-loss/endurance approval, monitoring, limits or recovery is missing; identity/topology/alignment changes; fio parsing/effective-depth validation fails; target becomes mounted/in use; monitoring is lost; any out-of-range I/O, media/controller error, disallowed latency/thermal/endurance state, device disappearance, host instability or failed recovery occurs.

identified_defects: No filename, size or offset defines the destructive target/range.
Installed system fio is invoked as an unproven local `./fio`.
M.2 transport is unspecified but V2 assumes PCIe.
Random/media/preconditioning/steady-state and quantified endurance acceptance are absent.
reason_for_change: Keep this specific QD1 random-write test intact while closing destructive-range and comparability gaps: V3 preserves 12 hours pending formal resolution, distinguishes NVMe from SATA M.2, proves 512-byte alignment, quantifies write/endurance impact and requires a defined steady-state rather than copying sequential-write logic.

new_technical_evidence.applicability: Installed fio version must be checked
new_technical_evidence.supports: filename and size bound the target; time_based loops for runtime; ramp_time precedes logged performance; iodepth is outstanding I/O and achieved distribution must be checked; parse-only can validate options without starting I/O.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Exact installed-version behavior, alignment, transport cache and device endurance telemetry remain platform-specific.

new_technical_evidence.supports: The randwrite/QD1/512B/one-job/direct-libaio/random-options profile, 43200-second runtime, generic criteria and 20/60-minute metadata.

removed_ambiguities: Separates random write from sequential-write and read-only neighbors.
Exposes 43200 seconds versus 60 minutes and forbids silent shortening.
Requires persistent bounded range and 512-byte alignment.
Makes random distribution, media preparation, steady-state and endurance evidence explicit.
resolved_blockers: fio, target/range and performance spec are provider-closable; destructive risk does not make the case inherently non-automatable.
remaining_blockers: Execution awaits target/range/transport, duration, alignment, exact job, random/media/steady-state/spec, data-loss/endurance approval and recovery.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 prevents duration drift and M.2 transport assumptions, adds 512-byte alignment and achieved-QD proof, separates setup from measurement, and binds random-write performance to stable media/cache state plus quantified endurance impact.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Contract-only validation was CLEAR. The isolated validator preserved one bounded destructive M.2 randwrite run with bs512, one job, effective QD1 and a full 43200-second measurement; treated M.2 as a form factor requiring NVMe/PCIe versus SATA/AHCI proof; required 512-byte O_DIRECT alignment, random/preconditioning/steady-state policy, host/NAND writes and endurance/write-amplification evidence; and rejected transient targets, range widening, 60-minute shortening, setup-only completion, cache/profile changes and retry. Missing target/profile/spec/approval are handoff gates, while unsupported alignment or unprovable safe target can legitimately block execution. No material document defect was found. This is not independent-model or DUT validation.
